_note: Part-by-part test (2026-11-16): split_parts.py isolates these from the concept, generate_3d.py makes each with Hunyuan3D + UltraTex, assemble_parts.py fits them onto the whole take. Boxes are concept pixels.

parts.name: head
parts.keep: the old troll woman's head: her face, big pointed ears and white hair, cut off cleanly at the bottom of the neck, with her two white braids ending just below her jaw; no shawl, no hood and no clothing

parts.name: head_bald
parts.keep: the old troll woman's head with her face and big pointed ears, but completely bald: no hair at all, no braids, a smooth bare wrinkled scalp with the same warty skin as her face, and a short piece of her neck; no shawl, no hood and no clothing
parts._why: Long hair came out as flat foil-like facets at 3k triangles; the hair is added in Blender as cards and braids instead (the user, 2026-11-16).
